scope: Table I and Eqs. (1), (4), (7), (10)–(16), (23)–(29); Figs. 6, 8 and 9 and Section III-C

assumptions.prefault_state: Solve Eqs. (12)–(16) at the Table I steady state. Preserve its continuous voltage integrator, phase and speed through the grid step. In a separate Fig. 9 k=0.30 sensitivity only, use the PDF start angle with nominal speed and algebraic prefault voltage at that angle.
assumptions.current: Ideal inner control and pure inductive electrical network as assumed in the paper. Currents are computed from phasors and measured current limiting is unavailable.
assumptions.headroom: Like the authors' gain-selection criterion, screen the unclipped controller voltage against 1.2 pu. Use the same gain in the ODE throughout the sag.
assumptions.phase_boundary: The fault is a permanent balanced sag. Classify gain selection by the first swing relative to the fault UEP and check the main time-domain cases separately.
assumptions.alternative_parameters: Use X=1/SCR for the independently stated 1.9 SCR. Retain an algebraic AVR as the fast-voltage sensitivity. The main gain selection uses the finite-kq model and the Table I X of 0.52 pu.
